Checkpoint and Catalog Persistence: immutable backing records, two publication boundaries
|-- [M] Record representation: expanded canvas history <-> stored references
|   |-- CanvasCheckpointEncoder exposes checkpoints + items + optional head map
|   |   |-- Split independently edited objects; parent skeletons preserve ordering
|   |   |-- SHA-256 identifies serialized value/text items; repeated sourceAscii is shared
|   |   `-- Compare reference maps -> added / updated / removed references
|   |       `-- Replay at most 31 delta links, then start a full reference map
|   |           `-- Keep logical parentId even when replay baseId is omitted
|   |-- Identity boundaries
|   |   |-- Checkpoint ID identifies a canvas snapshot with exact diagram revision bindings
|   |   `-- Diagram revision IDs identify revisions; blob hashes identify stored bytes
|   `-- DiagramPersistence exposes persist / restore / currentHistory
|       |-- Depends on checkpoint codec, domain validation and DiagramRecordStore
|       `-- Storage references stay internal; callers receive expanded documents
|
|-- [C] Autosave -> workspace manifest publication
|   |-- WorkspacePersistence projects live session changes into record batches
|   |   |-- Session cursors select changed history; current view is encoded separately
|   |   |   `-- View and history share immutable items; already stored items are omitted
|   |   `-- Index, metadata and graph changes travel together
|   |       `-- Session graph replacement removes obsolete checkpoints/revisions in that batch
|   |-- RecordStorage.batch -> local cache + coalesced pending changes
|   |   |-- Equal values queue no write; changed values schedule a deferred write
|   |   `-- One in-flight batch: {requestId, expectedRevision, changes}
|   |       |-- expectedRevision is the workspace storage revision, not a document version
|   |       |-- Acknowledgement advances that revision; later edits remain pending
|   |       `-- Failure retains the identical batch and requestId
|   |           |-- Transient error -> background retry with backoff
|   |           `-- Rejection or version/request-ID conflict -> stop background scheduling
|   |-- WorkspaceRecordStore.apply serializes writes per root within this process
|   |   |-- Check receipt before expectedRevision
|   |   |   |-- Same requestId + same batch hash -> return original workspace revision
|   |   |   `-- Changed batch under that ID -> conflict; new request with stale revision -> conflict
|   |   |-- Build and validate candidate records before publication
|   |   |   |-- Reject duplicate keys, changed existing revisions/items and invalid references
|   |   |   |-- Checkpoint re-encoding must preserve semantic state, excluding transactionId
|   |   |   `-- Cross-canvas transfers require participants and before/after checkpoints
|   |   |       `-- Destination checkpoint links the transfer; a move also requires the source link
|   |   `-- Write immutable blobs -> sync blob directory -> atomically replace and sync manifest
|   |       |-- Await all blob writers, including on failure, before leaving this operation
|   |       `-- Record references, new workspace revision and request receipt publish together
|   |           `-- Uncertain publication outcome -> retry the same ID to recover the receipt
|   |-- Explicit RecordStorage.commit adds an acknowledgement boundary
|   |   |-- Flush prior edits -> retain prior cache -> submit changes -> await acknowledgement
|   |   |-- REJECTED -> restore prior cache and discard abandoned queued changes
|   |   `-- Other errors -> keep retrying the identical request until success or disposal
|   |       `-- Caller contract: install the explicit UI transaction only after acknowledgement
|   `-- [O] Browser bridge owns subscriptions; RecordStorage owns cache, queue and timer
|       `-- Disposal releases subscriptions/timer; orderly close requires a preceding flush
|
|-- [C] Catalog publication -> published canvas heads
|   |-- CanvasCatalogStore exposes publication/acceptance; catalog rules decide composition
|   |   `-- Its private promise chain serializes operations within this store instance
|   |-- publishCheckpoint(input, captureCheckpoint)
|   |   |-- Matching request signature -> replay receipt before fresh capture/version checks
|   |   |-- Existing target must be settled and match expectedRevisionId
|   |   |   `-- This is a published canvas revision ID, not a bound diagram revision ID
|   |   |-- Invoke capture callback -> WorkspaceRecordStore.capture pins one manifest
|   |   |   |-- Require stored headId == requested checkpointId
|   |   |   |-- Require stored metadata.version == requested document version
|   |   |   `-- Hydrate selected head and bound revisions; retain pinned archive references
|   |   `-- Check repository ownership -> apply catalog rules -> atomically replace catalog
|   |       `-- Publish canvas revision + receipt referencing already autosaved workspace blobs
|   |-- acceptCanvasChanges(input)
|   |   |-- Prior acceptance for changeSessionId replays only for matching requestId/sessionVersion
|   |   |-- Require distinct documents/targets and matching expected published revisions
|   |   |-- Prepare candidate histories: fork new targets; adopt into existing saved histories
|   |   `-- Persist candidate backing records through DiagramPersistence, then replace catalog
|   |       `-- All accepted heads + before/after checkpoint receipt become visible together
|   |           `-- Failure before replacement publishes none of the candidate heads
|   `-- [O] Catalog retains published heads, history references and publication receipts
|       |-- Workspace manifest replacement and catalog replacement are separate commits
|       `-- Removing workspace references does not delete blobs still referenced by the catalog
|           `-- Failed writes may leave unreachable blobs; no blob reclamation is shown

`-- [D] Restored current canvas requires only its selected persisted graph
    |-- Catalog representation.currentRevisionId -> stored canvas history -> head checkpoint
    |   |-- Supplied head reference map -> direct item lookup
    |   `-- Otherwise -> bounded base-chain replay with depth, cycle and diff checks
    |-- Checkpoint reference map -> value items -> shared text items
    |   `-- Check item hashes and placeholders -> reconstruct document, view and bindings
    |-- Exact checkpoint revision bindings -> revision records -> diagram content
    |   `-- DiagramRevisionStore reads by hash and verifies bytes
    |       `-- Its workspace references resolve to the same blobs pinned during capture
    `-- DiagramPersistence.currentHistory -> validate and register bound revisions
        |-- Normally return one-head history without hydrating unrelated history
        |-- Saved/recording canvas views -> restore the wider graph they may reference
